title: Mark temporary API-compat shims with a removal comment and dedicated test file
answers: Where to put custom UnmarshalJSON for a generated apiserver type
Convention for temporary backward-compatibility code in grafana-app-sdk types
How to test legacy JSON decoding for an app type
body:
Fix pattern/convention: custom (de)serialization logic added only to support reading legacy data is placed in its own file alongside the generated type (e.g. field_requirement_json.go next to the generated field_requirement types), not hand-edited into generated files, and is paired with a dedicated _test.go covering legacy string input, new struct input, mixed slices, and malformed input (rejecting non-string/non-object JSON).
Constraints: the compatibility code carries an explicit comment stating it is temporary and naming the condition for removal (e.g. "once those policies are cleared"); apply this convention whenever adding a stopgap unmarshal/marshal override for a generated CRD/app-sdk type rather than editing the generated file.
applies: apps/* app-sdk generated API types that need temporary backward-compat decoding logic
